items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Jill Hughes, Joe Williams's wife's cousin, was there

ctx.x: We ran out of tape there, so do you want to back up just a little bit in the story? You --

Oh, yes. Okay. We'd had a nice time -- I'm speaking about Mercer and his son, young Edward, and myself, and we missed the morning plane going into Paris, and so fortunately we didn't have to work that night, but I was supposed to -- I had an appointment with my wife. She'd never been to Paris, you know, she'd never flown over all that water, and she was really cute. She cried, and when we got to the hotel, oh, Johnny Griffin, Ben Webster, Jimmy Wood$, the bass player that was formerly with Duke, and who else --…

"He's upstairs, but you can speak to his wife over there." So when I came downstairs, boy, she was swollen up as big as an elephant. The chicks had gone by then, you know. I said, "Baby, what's the matter?" And, you know, just had her jaw stuck out. We went to every theater, I guess I spent my whole salary on her that week, buying clothes, trying to -- and she broke up laughing. She said, "I caught you again, didn't I?" (Laughter)
